dct_title_s: Building Damage Assessment in Riosucio Town, Riosucio Municipality, Chocó Department, Colombia as of 20 November 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20241112COL, GDACS ID: 1102988** This map illustrates potentially affected structures in Riosucio Municipality, Chocó Department, Colombia as observed from a Pleiades satellite image acquired on 20 November 2024 at 11:07 Local Time. Within the analysis extent, UNOSAT identified 60 potentially affected structures amongst a total of 2,085 structures observed. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
